plugins.name: haikei
plugins.description: Build and operate AI assistants with the Kei platform: ABAC API org management, kei CLI platform administration, kei-proxy runtime for agent tool calls, runtime setup, model profiles (which model an agent uses), credential rotation, Entra directory sync, Open WebUI with Kei, harness setup for Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/Pi/Cursor, agentware SDK policy/audit middleware, first-agent beginner build with the open-source agentware SDK (no Kei account), Kei runtime setup diagnosis, operating Kei's own platform services (deploy, rollback, migrations, signing keys, KeiIdentity* alerts), and customer-assistant development (ingress security, Teams integration, tool adapters, headless evals, OpenAI backends), and resource-oriented API endpoint conventions (AIP-style routes, custom methods, migrations); connector operations contract authoring.
